en.title: 38 mm tires on an aero road bike: check the drivetrain, not just the headline
en.description: Compare Incolor Speedster SR, LightCarbon LCR018-D and Tavelo Arden clearance records, including 1×/2× limits and unresolved build details.
en.intro: “Fits 38 mm” is not a complete specification. The useful question is whether your exact frame generation, drivetrain and mounted tire fit together under the documented conditions. Three records in this catalog show why the distinction matters.

sections.heading: Three frames, three different qualifications
paragraphs: The Incolor Speedster SR record separates its 1× and 2× tire limits. Tavelo Arden also has drivetrain-dependent limits, but they are not the same as Incolor’s. LightCarbon LCR018-D has a manufacturer measured-width maximum; that wording should not be replaced with a more generous figure from a single owner’s build.

The comparison table pulls the current retained limits from those exact records. Incolor is a published configuration; the LightCarbon and Tavelo profiles remain research-stage records. Their inclusion here is useful for comparing documented constraints, not a claim that every buying question has been resolved.

sections.heading: Do not carry a 1× limit into a 2× build
paragraphs: When a manufacturer gives separate single- and double-chainring limits, use the one that applies to your drivetrain. A wider limit listed for the single-chainring setup does not establish compatibility with a front derailleur. Nor should it be copied to another frame from the same brand.

Start with the [Incolor Speedster SR model page](/models/incolor-speedster-sr-frameset/#source-records), then compare the [Tavelo Arden evidence](/models/tavelo-arden/#source-records). Retain the manufacturer’s qualification in the seller conversation rather than reducing either to one maximum number.

sections.heading: Ask for the actual wheel-and-tire combination
paragraphs: Record the exact tire model, nominal size and intended wheelset before asking about fit. Ask the manufacturer or seller which measurement basis its limit uses and whether any stated condition changes with frame size or drivetrain. Then confirm the intended setup against that documentation.

An owner photo can show that a particular build exists. It cannot, by itself, establish a supported maximum for every size, rim, tire or riding condition. For the LCR018-D, the retained record explicitly keeps larger owner fits separate from the manufacturer maximum.

sections.heading: Clearance is not a substitute for fit
paragraphs: The next comparison is geometry and cockpit adjustment. Check stack, reach, available spacers, stem options and seatpost arrangement for your intended size. A frame can solve your tire requirement while still failing your fit requirement.

Also compare the actual package: cockpit, seatpost, headset and small hardware may be included or separate. Use the [build tool](/build/) rather than comparing a bare frame quote with a complete frameset package. Keep unverified interfaces visible; the LightCarbon profile, for example, retains a disagreement between manufacturer and marketplace bottom-bracket dimensions instead of silently choosing one.

sections.heading: A practical purchase gate
paragraphs: Proceed only when the seller can identify the exact generation and size, confirm the drivetrain-specific tire limit, and document the included package. Ask for a written answer tied to the actual wheel and tire you plan to use. An unresolved answer should remain unresolved in your shortlist.

This article does not certify a build as safe, report a test ride or validate an oversized tire conversion. It explains how to use the catalog evidence without stripping away the conditions that make it meaningful.

zh-Hans.title: 气动公路车装 38 mm 轮胎：先确认单盘、双盘和实际胎宽
zh-Hans.description: 比较 Incolor Speedster SR、LightCarbon LCR018-D 与 Tavelo Arden 的轮胎空间记录，保留单／双盘限制和待确认细节。
zh-Hans.intro: “能装 38 mm”不是完整规格。真正的问题是：你选的车架代际、变速布局和实际轮胎，是否符合记录中的适用条件。目录中的三个例子说明了为什么不能只看一个最大数字。

sections.heading: 三个车架，三种不同限定
paragraphs: Incolor Speedster SR 的记录区分单盘和双盘上限。Tavelo Arden 也区分，但具体限制与 Incolor 并不相同。LightCarbon LCR018-D 则记录厂家按实测胎宽给出的最大值，不能用个别车主装过的更大轮胎替换这个标准。
下表读取这些具体记录中保留的限制。Incolor 属于已发布配置；LightCarbon 与 Tavelo 仍是研究阶段资料。把它们放在一起，是为了比较已有约束，不代表所有购买问题都已解决。

sections.heading: 不要把单盘上限套到双盘方案
paragraphs: 厂家分别规定单盘和双盘上限时，应采用与你的装车方案对应的那一个。单盘允许更宽，不等于装前拨也一样适用，更不能直接推广到同品牌的另一款车架。
先看 [Incolor Speedster SR 车型页](/models/incolor-speedster-sr-frameset/#source-records)，再比较 [Tavelo Arden 的证据](/models/tavelo-arden/#source-records)。向卖家询问时，应保留厂家的限定语，不要只报一个最大数字。

sections.heading: 询问具体轮组与轮胎组合
paragraphs: 询问兼容性前，先确定轮胎型号、标称尺寸和预期轮组。请厂家或卖家说明上限的测量口径，以及尺码或变速布局是否改变适用条件，然后再将计划中的搭配与资料核对。
车主照片能证明某个装车实例存在，却不能单独证明所有尺码、车圈、轮胎和路况都获得同样支持。LCR018-D 的保留记录就明确区分了较大轮胎的车主实例与厂家最大值。

sections.heading: 轮胎空间不能替代合身程度
paragraphs: 接着比较几何与把组调整：目标尺码的 Stack、Reach、可用垫圈、把立选项及座管形式。解决了胎宽需求，不代表同时解决了合身问题。
还要核对套餐内容：把组、座管、碗组和小配件可能包含，也可能另购。请用[装车工具](/build/)核算，避免把裸车架报价和完整车架套餐直接比较。未确认的接口应继续标明；例如 LightCarbon 资料保留了厂家与市场页面中轴尺寸的分歧，没有默默替读者选一个。

sections.heading: 实际下单的确认门槛
paragraphs: 下单前，让卖家明确车架代际与尺码、对应变速布局的轮胎上限，以及套餐内含部件。最好针对你实际要用的轮组和轮胎取得书面回复。答不清的问题，就继续作为待确认项保留。
本文不是装车安全认证，不是实际骑行测试，也不为超规格轮胎改装背书。它说明如何使用目录证据，并保留让这些信息有意义的条件。
